Krakauer11:00 AM CST on November 19, 2026Add Nautilus to GoogleAnd even when the external world has granted all it can, there still remain the searchings of the mind and the longings of the heart.—Arthur C. Clarke, Childhood's End, 1953As the world attempts to bring artificial intelligence into focus, it is hard to think of a modern scientific project with a wider range of implications for the future. Some hold that AI has already reached its maximum capabilities, while others maintain that we stand at the beginning of an exponentially expanding demigod, a singularity, the point beyond which it will be impossible for humans to comprehend the accelerating insights of a “super intelligence.”Subscribe to skip adsAdvertisement
